gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Technical and contemporary, Nippo looks cut from wire. The real hook is weight: Nippo's drawn-wire strokes hold the top, and Noto Sans Arabic stays light beneath with wide openings.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Noto Sans Armenian stands its lowercase tall and full, with inviting round letters. Noto Sans Armenian is the one to read at length, whereas Nippo is the one to look at, diagonals as sturdy as uprights.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Nippo draws its small letters nearly capital-sized, as if cut from wire. Noto Sans Balinese then reads gently, with breathing space inside every curve and ascenders kept short.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali keeps capitals barely taller than its lowercase. Nippo is best at wire-cut display strokes without pinched joints or flared ends, while the sans-serif body opens its letter mouths.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Nippo draws its lines like bent rope or tubing, and its small letters stand nearly capital-sized. Noto Sans Bhaiksuki coils its lowercase tight but keeps apertures open and readable.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Nearly capital-sized small letters give Nippo its flat, wire-cut look. Noto Sans Brahmi sets its mean line high and leaves every curve open-ended, so text moves along lightly and smoothly.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Nippo builds its rounded-rod letters in a single weight, small letters standing nearly capital-sized. And Noto Sans Buhid sits lightly beneath, its sans-serif curves leaving generous space before each stem.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-carian: Nippo keeps its strokes unshaded and constant, with small letters standing nearly capital-sized. Noto Sans Carian reads lightly and cleanly across paragraphs, its terminals held apart like open scissor blades.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Technical in feel, Nippo has small letters standing nearly capital-sized. Noto Sans Chakma is the friendlier half, packing lowercase up toward the caps with open s and c mouths.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee packs a tall band of letters with short stalks above. Over it, Nippo's wire-cut strokes make a heading you follow like a single thread, before the body's open e takes over.
